description_en: Creates a policy-based routing rule in the policy route table of an Enterprise Edition transit router
description_zh: 在企业版转发路由器的策略路由表中添加策略路由规则
name: CreateTransitRouterPolicyBasedRoute

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to only precheck the request. Valid values:

true: prechecks the request without creating the routing rule entry in the policy route table. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, the request format, and service limits. If the request fails the precheck, the corresponding error is returned. If the request passes the precheck, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): sends the request. After the request passes the precheck, the routing rule entry is created in the policy route table
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会在策略路由表中创建路由规则条目。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接在策略路由表中创建路由规则条目
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the policy routing table
parameters.name: policy_table_id

parameters.help_en:
The priority of the policy-based route. Valid values: 1 to 100.

The priority of each policy-based route in a policy route table of a transit router must be unique. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
parameters.help_zh:
策略路由的优先级。取值范围：1~100。

一个转发路由器策略路由表实例下，每个策略路由的优先级需保证唯一。数字越小，优先级越高
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en: The source CIDR block. The source CIDR block must be in CIDR format. Example: 192.168.1.0/24
parameters.help_zh: 源网段。源网段格式为CIDR格式。例如：192.168.1.0/24
parameters.name: source_cidr

parameters.help_en: The destination CIDR block of the route entry. Both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses are supported
parameters.help_zh: 路由条目的目标网段，支持 IPv4 地址和 IPv6 地址
parameters.name: destination_cidr

parameters.help_en:
The address family. Valid values:

IPv4
IPv6
parameters.help_zh:
地址族。可能值：

IPv4。
IPv6
parameters.name: address_family

parameters.help_en:
The protocol type of the traffic packet.

Traffic classification rules support matching traffic of various protocol types, such as HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, UDP, SSH, and Telnet. For more protocol types, log on to the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) console (https://cen.console.aliyun.com/cen/list)
parameters.help_zh:
流量报文的协议类型。

流分类规则支持匹配HTTP、HTTPS、TCP、UDP、SSH、Telnet等多种协议类型的流量。更多协议类型，请登录云企业网管理控制台 (https://cen.console.aliyun.com/cen/list)查看
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.help_en:
The source port. Valid values: -1 or 1 to 65535.

This parameter matches traffic whose port numbers fall within the source port range. If you do not specify this parameter, traffic from any source port is matched.

The port range is specified in the following formats:

80: port 80.
80/80: port 80.
1/200: ports 1 to 200.
-1/-1: all ports
parameters.help_zh:
源端口。取值范围：-1或1~65535。

匹配端口号在源端口范围中的流量，如果不设置则代表匹配任意源端口号的流量。

端口范围输入格式说明如下：

80，表示端口80。
80/80，表示端口80。
1/200，表示端口范围1至200。
-1/-1，表示匹配任意端口
parameters.name: source_port_range

parameters.help_en:
The destination port. Valid values: -1 or 1 to 65535.

This parameter matches traffic whose port numbers fall within the destination port range. If you do not specify this parameter, traffic to any destination port is matched.

The port range is specified in the following formats:

80: port 80.
80/80: port 80.
1/200: ports 1 to 200.
-1/-1: all ports
parameters.help_zh:
目的端口。取值范围：-1或1~65535。

匹配端口号在目的端口范围中的流量，如果不设置则代表匹配任意目的端口号的流量。

端口范围输入格式说明如下：

80，表示端口80。
80/80，表示端口80。
1/200，表示端口范围1至200。
-1/-1，表示匹配任意端口
parameters.name: dest_port_range

parameters.help_en:
The Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) value of the traffic packet to be matched. Valid values: 0 to 63.

The DSCP range is specified in the following formats:

1: traffic with a DSCP value of 1.
1/10: traffic with a DSCP value from 1 to 10.
-1/-1: traffic with any DSCP value
parameters.help_zh:
匹配流量报文的DSCP（Differentiated Services Code Point）值。取值范围：0~63。

端口范围输入格式说明如下：

1，表示匹配dscp为1的流量。
1/10，表示匹配dscp1至10的流量。
-1/-1，表示匹配任意dscp的流量
parameters.name: dscp

parameters.help_en: The name of the policy-based route
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the policy-based route
parameters.name: description

PolicyBasedRouteId.description_en: The instance ID of the policy-based routing rule
